property_mix.era: mixed post-war and modern, predominantly 1960s–1980s suburban
property_mix.notable: Thundersley is a commuter hamlet in south Essex with primarily residential family homes. Limited commercial or high-density development.

locksmith_relevant: Post-war suburban stock dominates; expect lever-handle and Yale-type locks on most domestic properties.
Aging bungalows and semi-detached houses may require updating of worn mortice locks and hinges.
New-build and renovation activity in the hamlet creates demand for modern multipoint and composite door locks.
